ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across the entire visible surface (~98%); high-intensity (white) pixels are minimal and restricted to localized scarring and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black pigmentation across both lobes with no large-scale mottling; small-scale high-contrast white linear disruptions on the left lobe and center-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch; calculated interior angle of approximately 60 degrees; depth extends significantly into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude varies from shallow undulations near the notch to sharp, multi-peak spikes towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory on the trailing edge moving from the notch towards the center of each lobe, transitioning to a convex curve at the outer tips; leading edges show a continuous convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, exhibiting an irregular, rough-textured geometry consistent with barnacle growth.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several fine, unaligned white linear marks on the inner left lobe and central right lobe, breaking the uniform black pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible irregular indentation on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe immediately adjacent to the central notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white calcification clusters isolated specifically at the furthest points of the left and right lobes.
